docs.title: Welcome on the GKC Blog website session
Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Nexus Repository Installation on Ubuntu Server
1. Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before installing Nexus Repository, ensure the Ubuntu server has:

  • Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS or later
  • Minimum 4 GB RAM
  • Minimum 20 GB free disk space
  • sudo or root access
  • Internet connectivity
  • A static IP address or DNS hostname

Update the system:

sudo apt update
sudo apt upgrade -y
